As a Cleanroom Logistics Operator in ASML's FOUP & Reticle department, you ensure that essential materials and tools arrive safely, cleanly and on time where they are needed. You handle specialised items such as FOUPs and reticles. FOUPs are containers that protect wafers from contamination and damage during storage and transport.
